relative_cost_basis: Approximate normalized cost. Values are initial estimates and can be refined from timing data.

features.name: natoms
features.label: Atom count
features.description: Number of atoms in the molecule.

features.name: amw
features.label: Average molecular weight
features.description: Average molecular weight, implicit hydrogens included. Isotopic atoms are treated as their natural abundance form. Unlike atom count this is not free, but it is only computed when requested.

features.name: nrings
features.label: Ring count
features.description: Number of SSSR rings.

features.name: heteroatom_count
features.label: Heteroatom count
features.description: Number of atoms whose atomic number is not carbon.

features.name: heteroatom_fraction
features.label: Heteroatom fraction
features.description: Fraction of atoms whose atomic number is not carbon.

features.name: aromatic_ring_count
features.label: Aromatic ring count
features.description: Number of aromatic rings.

features.name: aliphatic_ring_count
features.label: Aliphatic ring count
features.description: Number of non-aromatic rings.

features.name: rotatable_bonds
features.label: Rotatable bonds
features.description: Quick rotatable bond count using the molecule_filter rotatable-bond settings.

features.name: max_ring_system_size
features.label: Largest ring system size
features.description: Largest fused ring system, measured as number of rings in the system.

features.name: aromatic_rings_in_system
features.label: Aromatic rings in largest system
features.description: Largest number of aromatic rings found in a fused ring system.

features.name: tpsa
features.label: TPSA
features.description: Novartis topological polar surface area.

features.name: alogp
features.label: ALogP
features.description: ALogP value computed by the LillyMol ALogP implementation.

features.name: xlogp
features.label: XLogP
features.description: XLogP value computed by the LillyMol XLogP implementation.

features.name: hba
features.label: HBA
features.description: Hydrogen-bond acceptor count using molecule_filter Rule-of-Five logic.

features.name: hbd
features.label: HBD
features.description: Hydrogen-bond donor count using molecule_filter Rule-of-Five logic.

features.name: hba_rdkit
features.label: HBA (RDKit compatible)
features.description: Hydrogen-bond acceptor count matching RDKit's NumHAcceptors. NOT a Lipinski count - amide and sulfonamide nitrogen are excluded, aromatic nitrogen must be unsubstituted and two-connected, the hydroxyl of a carboxylic acid is excluded, and sulfur participates. Use hba for the rule of five.

features.name: hbd_rdkit
features.label: HBD (RDKit compatible)
features.description: Hydrogen-bond donor count matching RDKit's NumHDonors. NOT a Lipinski count - this counts heteroatoms carrying a hydrogen rather than hydrogens, and sulfur participates. Use hbd for the rule of five.

features.name: largest_ring_size
features.label: Largest ring size
features.description: Size of the largest ring. This does not span spiro fusions.

features.name: halogen_count
features.label: Halogen count
features.description: Number of F, Cl, Br, and I atoms.

features.name: max_distance
features.label: Longest path
features.description: Longest topological distance between any pair of atoms.

features.name: sp3_carbon
features.label: sp3 carbon count
features.description: Number of fully saturated carbon atoms.

features.name: sp3_carbon_fraction
features.label: sp3 carbon fraction
features.description: Fraction of carbon atoms that are fully saturated sp3 carbons. The denominator is the number of carbon atoms.

features.name: aromatic_density
features.label: Aromatic atom fraction
features.description: Fraction of atoms that are aromatic.

features.name: chiral
features.label: Chiral centre count
features.description: Number of chiral centres.

features.name: number_fragments
features.label: Fragment count
features.description: Number of disconnected fragments in the input smiles.

boolean_filters.label: Exclude non-organic molecules
boolean_filters.description: Reject molecules containing atoms outside LillyMol's organic subset.

boolean_filters.label: Exclude isotopic molecules
boolean_filters.description: Reject molecules containing isotopically labelled atoms.

utility_combinations.name: UTILITY_COMBINATION_WEIGHTED_AVERAGE
utility_combinations.label: Weighted average
utility_combinations.description: Sum weight_i * utility_i divided by sum weight_i. This is the default.

utility_combinations.name: UTILITY_COMBINATION_MIN
utility_combinations.label: Minimum
utility_combinations.description: Overall utility is the smallest individual utility value.

utility_combinations.name: UTILITY_COMBINATION_MAX
utility_combinations.label: Maximum
utility_combinations.description: Overall utility is the largest individual utility value.
